reason: The policy explicitly restricts item modification on pending orders: 'For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' This requires every modified item to have a corresponding new item as a variant replacement. The proposed action attempts to remove items entirely by passing empty new_item_ids, which violates this requirement. The policy provides no mechanism for removing or partially canceling individual items from pending orders—only full order cancellation or item-to-variant swaps are permitted. The user's request cannot be fulfilled within policy-authorized actions.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Modify pending order - product item options only within same-product variants
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders (but policy prohibits this specific action)
